caption:
A lead moves through four response windows whether you show up or not.

Window 1 (0-5 min): answer here and response-time research shows a near-double close rate.

Window 2 (5-60 min): most shops live here by default. About 17% of service businesses respond to a lead within the hour.

Window 3 (1-24 hr): the lead is comparing you to competitors. Silence reads as disinterest. Send pricing, past work, or FAQs instead.

Window 4 (1-30 days): most CRMs stop watching here. A check-in at day 3, 7, and 21 recovers leads everyone else wrote off.

Pull your last 10 leads and see which window you cover.
